name: livliv-desktop
description: LivLiv desktop shell: LivLiv Stage, or the website with a transparent stage window, global hotkeys and a local command endpoint
author: LivLiv

scripts.stage:pack: npm run build && npm run stage:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.stage.yml --dir
scripts.stage:mac: npm run build && npm run stage:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.stage.yml --mac
scripts.stage:win: npm run build && npm run stage:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.stage.yml --win
scripts.stage:dev: npm run build && npm run stage:web && electron . --app=stage
scripts.test:stage: npm run build && npm run stage:web && node test/stage.mjs
scripts.test:stage-api: npm run build && npm run stage:web && node test/stage-api.mjs
